card.title: 106th QUARTERMASTERS
card.text: When you gain an extra kredit slot, draw a card.
card.flavorText: During WWII the 106th Quartermaster Company were part of the 106th Infantry Division of the US Army. During the war the division participated in the Siegfried (Allied advance from Paris to the Rhine), the Battle of the Bulge, and lastly it took part in the Allied invasion of Germany. The 106th Quartermaster Company was responsible for supervising stores, barracks and distributing supplies and provisions for the division. The author Kurt Vonnegut served in the 106th Infantry Division and wrote about his experience in the Battle of the Bulge and later as a POW in Germany in his book “Slaughterhouse-Five”.
